description: This file is a shell script managing and monitoring Beerocks processes by performing tasks such as checking process health, killing or restarting processes if they are unresponsive, and logging slowdowns or stuck processes. It contains functions for process management, logic for periodic health checks, and error handling triggers.

methods.name: killall_program
methods.description: Kills processes with a specific program name, optionally with a specified signal.

methods.name: is_program_running
methods.description: Checks if a process with the given program name is currently running.
